pages.title: Planetary Geology
pages.text: $(thing)Planetary Geology$()$(br2)Every rocky planet sorts itself the same way: iron sinks to a core, rock floats above as mantle and crust. Comparing their cores tells how planets form.

$(thing)Insight$(): 200$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Mantle Geodynamics, Exoplanetology.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 4 Exoplanet Core Sample, 4 Ringwoodite.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): A planet of mass M and radius R, of even density, squeezes its centre. Write the pressure P there, with gravity's constant G.
